failure_story: Every saving in the plan is computed from a volume that is a fraction of the real one; the board sees a per-contact cost five times too high and a saving that cannot be found in any budget line
what_breaks_for_whom_when: Finance and the board, at the first quarterly review (April 2027)
evidence: support/tickets.csv (2,529 tickets in six months), support/phone-log.csv (3,194 calls), support/whatsapp-week-tally.csv (630 conversations in one week)
